title: Al-Qudwah, Not al-Talqeen: He Imitates What He Sees
summary: A child imitates his parents far more than he obeys their commands. When he sees you praying, making adhkar (remembrances of Allah), and treating people with akhlaq (good character), he absorbs the Deen as a living behaviour, not a lesson. Be the curriculum yourself.
try_this: This week: Let your child see you in a moment of ‘ibadah (worship) or beautiful akhlaq, without commanding him to do anything.
reflection_prompts: What does your child imitate from you?
What qudwah (example) did you offer this week?
